partyLane.sourceMethod: A frozen snapshot of the original code-native party combat keys is extended at native resolution with explicitly authored phase selection, integer upper-body mechanics, weapon/VFX arcs, timing, pivots, and event frames.

enemyTriggerLane.sourceMethod: A frozen snapshot of the existing deterministically pixelified four-direction enemy field atlas is extended with integer-native trigger poses and code-native encounter indicators. The underlying enemy pixels remain derivative of AI-generated concept boards.

geometry.facing: south trigger keys; runtime movement retains four-direction source atlas

triggerContract.sense: player has entered awareness radius; no settlement or contact
triggerContract.alert: encounter-alert event fires on active frame and starts readable grace window
triggerContract.pursue: simulation owns pursuit movement and facing
triggerContract.engage: encounter-contact fires exactly once on contact frame
triggerContract.cooldown: failed contact or escaped player returns trigger to dormant without campaign mutation
